verdict.rationale: Base44 documents a JS SDK (entities CRUD, auth), a CLI, and an App MCP server letting external AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) interact with published apps, all backed by concrete code samples — a real, documented programmatic surface for AI-native use. However, no formal OpenAPI/REST spec exists (probe found 404s on all candidate openapi.json paths), so the 'public API' is SDK/CLI/MCP-based rather than a conventional documented REST API.
